opening.argument: The video promotes a purported free $1,500 Chipotle gift card as a low-barrier reward and directs viewers to an external Blogspot link to claim it. The title presents a "$1,500 Chipotle Gift Card" as a deal or prize, while the description says, "Take this deal and Win a $1,500 Chipotle GIft Card ! Check this: http://chipotlegiftcarddeal.blogspot.com". The available evidence shows no eligibility terms, Chipotle authorization, destination behavior, payment, data collection, or completed outcome, but the promised reward and claim instruction are plainly presented.
